name: Sparkle Star
source:
Sparkle is a normal girl who just wishes she could be a hero, but what will happen when she really gets her wish?

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/sparklestar.html]Otaku World[/url]]
translation:
小閃是個普通女孩，一心希望自己能成為英雄。可要是有一天真的如願，又會發生什麼？
